EXCISE ORDINANCE
Excise Notification
AMENDMENT OF REGULATIONS ON NON POTABLE SPIRITS IMPORTED INTO SRI LANKA

IT is hereby notified that the following Order issued by the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance, by virtue of thepowers vested in him by Section 2, 12, 22 and 25, read together the Section 32 of the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52), asamended, and published as the Excise Notification No. 10/ 2018 in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2075/ 23 dated June13, 2018, in order to amend the Excise Notification No. 07/ 2018, published in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2059/ 32dated February 21, 2018, with the view to update and simplify the rules applicable on importation of non-potable spirits,was passed by parliament on September 20, 2018.
S. R. ATTYGALLE,
Secretary,Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs.Ministry of Finance and Economic AffairsColombo 01,November 15, 2018.
RULES

1.repealing ‘‘any non- potable spirit’’ of the sub-section V of paragraph 3 and substituting thereof with ‘‘Methyl.1. ol (CH3- OH) spirits’’ and substituting ‘‘institutions approved by the Government’’ in place of ‘‘aninstitution approved by the Government’’ in the same paragraph,
2.insertion immediately after first paragraph of the sub-section V of thereof the following paragraph,
‘‘Commissioner General reserves the power to order to add the approved denaturants to the other non-potable spirits specified in the Schedule I of this Notification’’
